Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: An agent skill definition adhering to the SKILL.md specification and ingestion pipeline format.

id.description: Unique identifier for the skill record.

name.description: Slug / machine identifier of the skill matching SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Comprehensive description of the skill and its trigger preconditions.

category.description: Primary domain category e.g. Meta-Engineering, Neuromorphic, Orchestration.

authorId.description: UID of the user who registered or created this skill.

skillMarkdown.description: Raw content of the SKILL.md file including YAML frontmatter and operational guidelines.

summaryJson.description: Pre-parsed JSON summary for instantaneous ingestion pipeline indexing and routing.

parameters.description: Serialized parameter definitions and schemas accepted by this skill.

examples.description: Detailed multi-turn interaction and invocation examples for agent in-context prompting.

references.description: Serialized list of documentation, research papers, and technical citations.

dependencies.description: Serialized list of required libraries, tool declarations, and runtime constraints.

codeFiles.description: Serialized map of executable/scaffolded code files associated with the skill.

status.description: Lifecycle readiness state of the skill.

isPublic.description: Whether this skill is publicly discoverable across all agent engines.

securityClearance.description: Attribute-based access control clearance tier from Studio Alchemist registry.

sourceReferences.description: Serialized list of notebook source links or document keys.

isExecutable.description: Whether this skill provides active tool execution bindings for runtime invocation.

runtime.description: Target runtime execution environment (MCP protocol, in-process worker, or cloud function).

returns.description: JSON Schema definition for the output / return structure.

embedding.description: 768-dimensional float vector embedding for dynamic semantic tool selection.

parametersSchema.description: Serialized map of tool call parameter schemas and signatures.

returnsSchema.description: Serialized map or JSON schema of expected tool return signature.

bundleFiles.description: Serialized map of file pointers: guidelinesMd, runtimeScript, runtimeFilename.

bundleStoragePath.description: Cloud Storage path pointing to GCS bucket (e.g. gs://bucket/skills/{skillId}/).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp string.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp string.

ExecutionTrace.title: ExecutionTrace
ExecutionTrace.description: Operational subcollection tracking tool invocation telemetry, performance, and node status.

callerClearance.description: Clearance level asserted at invocation time.

inputParams.description: Sanitized arguments passed to the tool.

latencyMs.description: Total round-trip execution latency in milliseconds.

errorMessage.description: Failure reason or error message if unsuccessful.

AgentMemory.title: AgentMemory
AgentMemory.description: Vector indexed agent memory record for semantic, episodic, and procedural recall.

id.description: Unique identifier of the memory item.

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent instance owning this memory.

content.description: Textual context, conversational observation, or procedural step.

embedding.description: Vector(768) embedding representation for semantic retrieval.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public profile information for skill engine contributors.

/skills/{skillId}.description: Global and user skill registry entries.

/skills/{skillId}/executions/{executionI.description: Operational subcollection for tool invocation telemetry and runtime tracing.

/users/{userId}/public/profile.description: Public user profile following split collection isolation.
